absent.note: I will check service health first

annotations.rationale: A formal customer reports staff abroad stuck in MFA prompts and then blocked. The engineer announces a service health check, does it, asks for users, times and recent policy changes, and the customer names a policy rolled out the day before with the wrong assignment. The sign-in logs show the interrupted and blocked rows with the policy name. The engineer suggests narrowing the assignment and a one-user exclusion as a test, which works, and checks the logs after the change. The signals are the customer's change report, the log rows and the clear service health; the exclusion works, so there is no no-effect signal.
